Strategy: An exact fit earns a very large bonus, a leftover of at most 10 earns a small bonus, and otherwise Best Fit applies, so near-perfect fits outrank merely tight ones. The ranking differs from Best Fit when an exact or near-exact bin is not the tightest available. It may help by harvesting perfect fits aggressively, or fail because the small bonus may prefer a poor bin over a good tight one.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [((1000 if r == item else (50 if r - item <= 10 else 0)) - (r - item)) for r in bins]
```
